claim: Imports signed-amount CSVs and CSVs with separate debit and credit columns.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert sample signed totals, then import a debit/credit fixture and assert its totals.

claim: Remembers column, date-order, and amount-sign choices locally.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; import custom headings, start a second import, and assert every saved choice is restored.

claim: Restores reviews, merchant rules, notes, and checklist state after reload.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; change a rule, note, and check, reload, and assert all changes remain.

claim: Applies explicit merchant cleanup rules without hiding the source description.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; add a rule and assert the resulting merchant, category, and original description.

claim: Splits a mixed purchase into two category amounts.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; split one exact amount and assert both new categories appear in the comparison.

claim: Finds monthly, weekly, and fortnightly repeat-charge candidates.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; assert a named sample candidate for each cadence.

claim: Compares category spending for the newest two imported months.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; assert month names, both spending totals, and a category result.

claim: Exports the shown review checklist as Markdown.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; download Markdown and match its checklist row count to the visible list.

claim: Exports normalized transactions as CSV.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; download CSV and assert its header, row count, and normalized merchant row.

claim: Exports, validates, restores, and clears local review data.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; export a marker, reject invalid JSON, reset, restore the valid backup, then clear it.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context at /demo; install the worker, disable the network, reload, and assert saved output and offline status.

claim: Opens a populated two-month sample without reading or changing real review data.
sandbox: Fresh context with a sentinel in the real database; enter /demo in one click, edit and reset it, then assert the real sentinel is unchanged.

claim: Does not connect to a bank or ask for bank credentials.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow; complete repeat-charge output, assert no credential control, and assert all requests remain on origin.

claim: Does not upload statement rows.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; import a unique row while recording requests, then assert no request is cross-origin or contains the row.

claim: Discards original CSV text after import unless retention is selected.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; import with retention unselected and inspect the stored review for the absent sourceCsv field.

claim: Uses no analytics or tracking.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow with a request log; assert no request leaves the product origin.

claim: Sends only the license token during an optional Plus verification request.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context with a recorded fixture response; assert the request is GET with one license query field and no body.

claim: Provides arithmetic observations, not financial advice or cloud categorization.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; export the review warning and assert the workflow makes no model request.

claim: Keeps importing, comparisons, checklists, and exports free.
sandbox: Fresh real-data namespace without a license; import two months, compare them, and download an export.

claim: Offers Plus for US $19 once with no subscription; new checkout is unavailable until billing registration completes.
where: landing Plus section, Plus dialog, README, terms
sandbox: Fresh landing page; assert exact price and availability copy, then assert there is no link to the currently unavailable checkout.

claim: Lets a Plus user retain an original CSV locally after explicit selection.
sandbox: Fresh Plus-enabled /demo context; select retention, import, and assert exact source text in the demo database.

claim: Lets a Plus user save more than five merchant rules.
sandbox: Fresh Plus-enabled /demo context; save six rules and assert all six are present with no limit error.

claim: Restores a Plus license on another browser.
sandbox: Fresh browser with a recorded verification response; paste a fixture token and assert verified local access.

claim: Loads runtime code, fonts, images, and service worker only from the product origin.
sandbox: Fresh landing page; record requests and performance resources and assert every origin matches the product.
